description: Controlled matched evaluation of selective recovery policies (Cheap Filter, Eviction-Only, Terminal-Only, and Combined) against Resumption Baseline and Terminal-Reserve Control.
prior_data_exposure: Development/validation partition (random-64-64-10, warehouse-10-20-10-2-2). Untouched test partition remains strictly unexposed.

policies.name: RESUMPTION_NO_PA
policies.description: Normal checkpoint resumption baseline (K=2, FIFO selective); recovery disabled

policies.name: PA_EVERY_INTERRUPTION_FILTERED
policies.description: Cheap-filtered partial acceptance evaluated on every slice interruption

policies.name: PA_EVICTION_ONLY
policies.description: Normal resumption; recovery attempted only upon natural checkpoint eviction

policies.name: PA_TERMINAL_ONLY
policies.description: Normal resumption; recovery attempted only during 2.0 ms terminal reserve before deadline

policies.name: PA_EVICTION_AND_TERMINAL
policies.description: Normal resumption; recovery attempted on eviction and during terminal reserve

policies.name: TERMINAL_RESERVE_CONTROL
policies.description: Control ablation: stops normal search early at 2.0 ms reserve without recovery

accounting: 2 maps * 2 scenarios * 2 agent scales * 2 budgets * 2 seeds = 32 matched cells * 6 variants = 192 total runs
